close_reason: fixed: test now asserts seen.len() > 1 for sub-second uniqueness
description: helpers.rs test now_utc_string_subsecond_uniqueness (line 137) collects 10 timestamps into a HashSet but then does 'let _ = seen;' — it never calls assert\!. The test passes vacuously regardless of clock behavior. Comment says 'We accept this test as documentation, not a hard guarantee' but the effect is a test that contributes zero coverage signal. Maintenance consequence: a regression in sub-second precision would not be caught; future maintainers believe subsecond uniqueness is tested when it is not.
title: now_utc_string_subsecond_uniqueness test never asserts
